# Singhs Print

> Custom apparel printing shop in Sainte-Anne-de-Bellevue, in Montreal's West Island (Quebec, Canada). We print and embroider t-shirts, hoodies, hats, polos, jackets and workwear for businesses, schools, teams, events and community groups. Orders are placed online; we ship across Canada.

## What we do

- Decoration methods: DTG (direct-to-garment), DTF (direct-to-film) and embroidery. We do not run screen printing.
- Garments: about 4,600 blank styles from Gildan, Bella+Canvas, Comfort Colors, Next Level, Champion, Independent Trading Co., ATC, Stormtech, Carhartt and others. We also decorate garments the customer supplies.
- Minimum order: 5 pieces, counted across the whole order, for DTG/DTF and embroidery.
- Turnaround: 5-10 business days from approved artwork. Rush in 3 business days for 25% extra.
- Pricing: live per-unit prices on the site at the quantity you choose; the price per piece drops as quantity goes up. Sizes 2XL and up add $3 per piece.
- Proofing: a mockup is sent for approval before anything is printed.
- Payment terms: Net-30 is available for approved repeat accounts.
- Languages: English and French.

## Service area

- Local pickup at the shop in Sainte-Anne-de-Bellevue, and local delivery in the West Island and Montreal.
- Canada-wide shipping.
